**Chosen change:** Add a "Print" button to `site/license.html` so visitors can print the license page. The button will use the existing `printPage()` function in `app.js` (which is already wired to any element with `id="print-page-btn"`). This is a single-file, user-facing improvement that follows the pattern already established on `index.html` and `colophon.html`.

**Files to rewrite:**
1. `site/license.html` – insert a print button in the main content area.
2. `MEMORY.md` – append a dated note recording this addition.

**Risk assessment:** Very low. The change only adds a button element with an ID that the existing JavaScript already handles. No new JavaScript, no CSS changes, no structural modifications. The button will be styled by the existing `.copy-btn` class. If the JavaScript fails to find the element, it simply does nothing (optional chaining).
